article.headline: Zeta Global Jumps 6% After Earnings Call Highlights Higher Outlook
article.deck: The stock traded as high as 35.44 inside a five-week cup and sits 1.6% under the 34.90 buy point, with the buy range running to 36.65.
body: Zeta Global rose 1.92, or 5.9%, to 34.34 as of 1:28 p.m. Mountain, the session after its third-quarter report. The stock is working on a five-week cup, 15.6% deep, with a buy point of 34.90 and a buy range up to 36.65. It traded as high as 35.44 today, above the buy point, then slipped back to sit 1.6% below it. Volume is on pace for 1.62x its 50-day average.

Today's low touched the 50-day line, now 31.79, and the stock turned up off it; the session's range also crossed the 21-day line at 32.19, so it reads 0.0 ATRs from the 21-day line. The 52-week high is 35.75, 3.9% overhead. The RS line is at a new high and the stock holds RS rank 98 of 99 on the desk's list. Shares are up 68.7% year to date and 76.0% over the past year. The early entry at the handle high of 32.91 from Nov. 4 is already cleared; the desk's other early entry is a move above today's 35.44 high, with the 50-day line as the stop.

The latest quarter in the table, June, shows earnings of 3 cents a share on revenue of $442.8 million, up 43.5% from a year earlier. Earnings have swung between small gains and small losses over the four quarters given. Zeta carries a market value of $8.55 billion and a forward P/E of 25.7.
The September-quarter numbers are not in the table yet. Headlines from GuruFocus and Zacks say the earnings call highlighted record 46% revenue growth, AI growth and a higher outlook.
A close above 34.90 puts the stock through the buy point; a close back under the 50-day line breaks the bounce.
article.watch: Watch for a close above the 34.90 buy point, with 35.44, today's high, the first level to clear.

article.headline: Pfizer Edges Up After Posting Phase 3 Elrexfio Win
article.deck: Pfizer sits a penny under its 29.31 flat-base buy point, inside a buy range that runs to 30.78, after a bounce off the 50-day line.
body: Pfizer rose 7 cents, or 0.2%, to 29.30 as of 1:28 p.m. Mountain. The stock broke out of a six-week flat base, 7.2% deep, on Oct. 15 at a 29.31 buy point, on 0.97x its 50-day average volume. Eighteen sessions later it is back at the start line, a penny below the buy point, with the buy range running to 30.78. Volume is light, on pace for 0.61x its 50-day average.

Today's low touched the 50-day line, at 28.78, and the stock held above it; it sits 1.8% over the line. The high stayed under the 21-day line at 29.57, a reading of -0.26 ATRs from the 21-day line, so the short-term trend has flattened rather than broken. The 52-week high of 31.44 is 6.8% above. The stock holds RS rank 70 of 99 on the desk's list, with the RS line 11.0% below its high. Shares are up 17.7% this year and 19.9% over the past year.

The September quarter brought earnings of 56 cents a share, down 9.7% from a year earlier, on revenue of $16.58 billion, down 0.4%. Earnings in the three quarters before ran -4 cents, 47 cents and -29 cents. The next report is due Feb. 2, 2027. The market values Pfizer at $166.9 billion and 9.97 times forward earnings.
Simply Wall St. reported that Pfizer posted a Phase 3 win for Elrexfio and is expanding its AI research push.
A close under the 50-day line would turn this into a failed breakout; a move back toward 30.78 puts it in the upper half of the range.
article.watch: Watch the 50-day line at 28.78; the breakout holds as long as the stock stays above it.

article.headline: Grainger Rises 1.6% In A Down Market After Earnings Beat
article.deck: Grainger trades 3.6% past its 1,420.01 flat-base buy point, still inside a buy range that tops out at 1,491.01.
body: W.W. Grainger rose 22.98, or 1.6%, to 1,470.65 as of 1:28 p.m. Mountain while all three major indexes traded lower. The stock broke out on Nov. 4 from a 15-week flat base, 12.9% deep, past a 1,420.01 buy point; that session traded 2.39x its 50-day average volume. Four sessions later it sits 3.6% above the buy point, inside a buy range that runs to 1,491.01. Today's volume is on pace for 0.74x average.

The 52-week high of 1,521.41 is 3.3% above. The stock is 1.52 ATRs from the 21-day line, now at 1,384.96, and 11.6% above its 50-day line at 1,318.18, so the trend is intact and not stretched. It holds RS rank 92 of 99 on the desk's list, with the RS line 0.9% from its high. Shares are up 45.7% this year and 54.0% over the past year.

September-quarter earnings came to 12.42 a share, up 102.9% from a year earlier, on revenue of $5.18 billion, up 11.3%. Quarterly earnings have climbed in each period given: 9.44, 11.65, 12.01 and 12.42. The next report is due Feb. 2, 2027. Grainger carries a market value of $68.8 billion and a forward P/E of 28.2.

Headlines since the report point to an earnings beat, and MarketBeat ran highlights from the third-quarter call. Fastenal, another industrial on the desk's list, also broke out of a flat base this week.
A close back under 1,420.01 would leave the breakout stalled; above 1,491.01 the stock is extended.
article.watch: Watch whether the stock holds above the 1,420.01 buy point, with the 21-day line at 1,384.96 as the next support.
